name: DENTEX training data, quadrant-enumeration-disease subset (already local)
classes: Caries, Deep Caries, Impacted, Periapical Lesion
limitations: no patient ids; class definitions not published in detail

name: DENTEX official validation set (labels released after the challenge)
annotation_format: COCO JSON, same categories_1/2/3 ids and names as the training file
classes: Caries 101, Deep Caries 32, Impacted 40, Periapical Lesion 9 (182 findings, 46 images with findings)
limitations: 20/50 images are byte-identical to DENTEX quadrant / enumeration radiographs (they inherit that split); small

name: DENTEX official test set (test_data.zip)
status: downloaded, inventoried, not used for training or evaluation
limitations: on test_181 (byte-identical to training train_332) the Turkish labels disagree with the English ones; 95/250 images are byte-identical to DENTEX training-subset radiographs

name: Dental OPG XRAY Dataset (Mendeley c4hhrkxytw v4)
paper_or_docs: dataset page only, no journal paper cited
image_type: panoramic (captured with an Android phone camera, per the page)
images_confirmed: not downloaded; page states 232 originals + 604 augmented
classes: Healthy Teeth, Caries, Impacted Teeth, Broken Down Crown/Root, Infection, Fractured Teeth
supports_target_classes: Impacted only (semantic); Caries not split by depth; 'Infection' undefined
limitations: phone photographs of films (strong domain shift); augmented copies mixed in; minority classes not supported

name: Four common dental diseases (Mendeley wxv6h9p39g v1)
images_confirmed: not downloaded; page states 4000 original + 10000 augmented
supports_target_classes: none exactly: Cavities not split by depth, Infection undefined, wisdom tooth != impacted
limitations: taxonomy incompatible; augmented images mixed with originals

name: Children's dental panoramic radiographs (Sci Data 2023)
license: article CC BY 4.0; data licence not stated in the article
classes: Caries, Periapical infection, Pulpitis, Deep sulcus, developmental abnormalities, Others
supports_target_classes: none exactly (caries not split by depth; 'periapical infection' undefined vs DENTEX)
limitations: paediatric mixed dentition: large domain shift vs DENTEX (patients >= 12)

name: Tufts Dental Database
classes: abnormality descriptions in five levels (not the DENTEX four)
limitations: requires the user to request access; mapping to the four classes would need clinical review

name: OdontoAI
classes: teeth only (no diagnoses in the public release, per literature)
status: rejected for the classifier (could serve detection/numbering only)
limitations: a 2024 BMC Oral Health study added diagnosis labels to OdontoAI; its data-availability statement could not be retrieved (publisher page blocked automated access), so no released labels are assumed
